alate: Head deep yellowish brown; antennae yellowish brown; anteclypeus nearly white, postclypeus and labrum brownish yellow; pronotum yellowish brown, legs brownish yellow; wing membrane transparent with blackish brown veins; abdominal tergites deep brownish yellow. The head is sparsely covered with short hairs mixed with a few long hairs. Head subcircular in dorsal view, the crescent-shaped antennal bands distinct. Compound eyes subcircular, projecting beyond the lateral margins of the head; ocelli elongate-oval, slightly raised, closely adjacent to the compound eyes but not touching, the distance about half the short diameter of the ocellus. Labrum semicircular, slightly wider than long; postclypeus a narrow transverse band; postmentum hourglass-shaped, longer than wide, the lateral margins arcuately projecting. Antennae 17-segmented, segments 2 and 3 smaller, enlarging gradually from segment 4 onwards, fusiform from segment 8 onwards. Left mandible with three marginal teeth, the first smaller than the third and larger than the second; right mandible with two adjacent marginal teeth. Pronotum narrower than the width of the head including the eyes, the median notch of the anterior margin slightly distinct. Forewing slightly longer than the hindwing, the media arising from the humeral suture and unbranched, joining the radial sector but nearer the cubitus; cubitus with about 16 branches.
